title: Loved by researchers
subtitle: Real teams, calmer workflows.
description: Researchers, designers, and PMs use Trail to keep decisions, sources, and context together.

items.name: Maya C.
items.quote: The app removed the tab chaos. We stop losing decisions even when research runs for weeks.

items.name: Sofia P.
items.quote: It stays out of the way. Collecting sources and notes feels fast and clean.

items.name: Olivia G.
items.quote: One link instead of a long recap. The team jumps in with full context.

items.name: Daniel R.
items.quote: It saves hours. Open a path and continue exactly where you left off.

items.name: Jamal R.
items.quote: We share context, not screenshots. Syncs move faster.

items.name: Alex B.
items.quote: Returning to a topic no longer takes hours. It preserves the path.

items.name: Priya S.
items.quote: Stakeholders finally see the full path, not just a summary slide.

items.name: Lucas M.
items.quote: The app keeps an audit-friendly record of every source we used.

items.name: Ana L.
items.quote: Switching between map views helps me explain research paths fast.
